method: Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) — highway ways in 0.16deg bbox per corridor, fetched 2025-11 live. Counts prove OSM road presence; R1-R4 demo topology is centroid-aligned (not OSM trace) to keep deterministic R2-avoidance pedagogical. Full OSM traces available on demand (NH310A trunk verified for Gangtok).
note: Lachung 226 under-count reflects sparse Himalayan network, not missing data. Darjeeling 504 on retry (429/504 backoff). R1-R4 fixture geometry retained for routing determinism; OSM count is the honesty proof, not invented roads.
